title: Shoei RF-1400 Multi-Density Cheek Pads
features: OEM multi-density polyurethane foam tailored specifically for Shoei RF-1400 / NXR 2 helmets
Emergency Quick Release System (E.Q.R.S.) red pull-tabs for medical emergency removal
Max-Dry moisture-wicking and quick-drying antimicrobial fabric lining
Available in standard (35mm) and custom tuning thicknesses (31mm, 39mm, 43mm)
description:
Designed to optimize interior helmet ergonomics and temperature regulation, the Shoei RF-1400 Multi-Density Cheek Pads from Shoei keeps riders dry, focused, and comfortable across grueling saddle stints. Built with Hydrophilic Moisture-Wicking Core with Fast-Evaporating Air-Mesh Outer, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct snap-tab alignment into EPS cheek-pad / liner channels).

Engineered for all-season comfort, the Shoei RF-1400 Multi-Density Cheek Pads from Shoei delivers exceptional moisture management and skin comfort, shielding riders from biting wind-chill and summer humidity.
